infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Boomer AI uses the microphone so you can speak your questions instead of typing them, anywhere in the app.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Boomer AI uses your photo library so you can share a photo with your AI guide to ask about it, and to set your profile picture.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Boomer AI uses the camera so you can take a photo to ask your AI guide about it, and to take your profile picture.
